name: spotlight-new
title: Spotlight
description: A black hero backdrop with two wide diagonal shafts of pale blue light that drift slowly in opposite directions behind centred white copy.
use: A dark hero needs depth behind centred copy without carrying an image or video.
avoid: Purely decorative and always moving: it adds nothing on pale themes and cannot be paused.
a11y: Purely decorative and always in motion, with no reduced-motion check and no pointer interaction. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage with two broad, blurred light shafts falling inward from the upper corners in pale blue, forming a soft V over the middle. A white headline and a grey subline sit centred on top.
behaves: Each pair of gradient panels slides sideways a short distance and eases back on a slow loop, so the light gently breathes behind the text. Nothing responds to the pointer.
customise: All three gradients, beam width, height, vertical offset, travel distance and loop duration are props; the rotation and layering are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Two blurred gradient panels translate on a slow loop; no canvas and few nodes.
demo: Headline 'Ship in days, not quarters.' and a line about one workspace for specs, reviews and releases.
polishWhy: Soft, well-balanced light that frames the copy; the drift is almost imperceptible.
